commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update attribute reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update attribute apply --plan <plan-name>

commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update attribute group apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update attribute group reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update attribute group apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates or updates an attribute group; reorganizes attribute grouping in the PIM's data-entry UI, a low-risk organizational mutation
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update category apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update category reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update category apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates or updates a category node; re-parenting an existing category changes the catalog tree for every product classified under it
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update channel apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update channel reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update channel apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates or updates a distribution channel; changes which locales/currencies/category tree every product exported to this channel uses
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update family apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update family reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update family apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates or updates a product family definition; changes the required/optional attribute set for every product assigned to this family
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update family variant apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update family variant reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update family variant apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates or updates a family variant's axis/attribute-set structure; changes which attributes distinguish variant products under this family
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update product apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update product reverse-ETL action
examples: pm akeneo create or update product apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new product (201) or updates an existing one (204) in the connected Akeneo PIM catalog; visible to every downstream channel the product is enabled/categorized for
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update product model apply
